# Ilse Tarkand

Ilse Tarkand was a structural engineer born in 1874 in Harrow Vale.
She studied civil engineering at Northmere Polytechnic and graduated in 1897.

## Career

Tarkand worked for the Osk River Commission from 1899 to 1920. Her best-known
work is the Velmora Bridge. She retired to the coastal village of Brenna Sound,
where she died in 1951.
